text:
The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Here is an alternative ending for the story:

As the blades descended, Clara didn't just hold her breath; she exhaled sharply, timing her movement to the exact millisecond the metal bars passed her shoulders. Instead of freezing in fear, she utilized the momentum of the falling blades to swing her body sideways, slipping through the narrow gap with a grace that defied physics. The crowd gasped, not in horror, but in awe, as she emerged from the contraption unscathed, bowing to a standing ovation. Her ambition had not led her too far; it had led her to perfection, securing her place not just as a magician, but as a legend.
